payload.title: All-Inclusive Greece Wedding Packages Compared
payload.excerpt: Search for Greece wedding packages all inclusive and you will meet a dozen resorts using the same words for very different things.
key_takeaways: A Greek venue wedding package usually covers the ceremony set-up, a coordinator and a short list of touches, with the reception menu and drinks quoted separately.
Where a Greek resort calls itself all inclusive, the phrase almost always describes the holiday stay rather than the wedding package.
Guest room minimums, exclusive use, music finish times and outside suppliers are where Greek packages differ most, so ask for each in writing.
Compare two quotes only on the same guest count, spaces, hours, nights and currency, with every inclusion listed.

faq.q: What is included in an all-inclusive wedding package in Greece?
faq.a: It depends on the venue. Most packages cover the date and ceremony set-up, a coordinator, flowers for the couple, a cake and a toast. The reception menu and drinks are usually quoted separately.

faq.q: Are there all-inclusive wedding resorts in Greece?
faq.a: Yes, as holidays. Ikos Aria on Kos belongs to a resort brand where everything is included in the stay, and Grecotel Amirandes on Crete offers an all inclusive meal plan. The wedding package at each is a separate, named list.

faq.q: Do all-inclusive Greece wedding packages have a minimum guest number?
faq.a: Some do. Abaton requires a reception of at least 20 guests, and Santorini Gem's set menus start at 20 adults. Canaves sells a package for the couple alone.

faq.q: Do all-inclusive packages in Greece include flights or guest rooms?
faq.a: Not flights. Guest rooms are more often a requirement than an inclusion: Elounda SA asks the couple to stay three nights, and Abaton asks for at least 10 rooms for at least 2 nights. Four Seasons Astir Palace includes the couple's wedding night.

faq.q: Are there all-inclusive elopement packages in Greece?
faq.a: There are elopement packages, though none are sold as all inclusive. Canaves has a Panorama Balcony elopement for the couple alone, with private use for up to 5 hours and a two-tier cake. Euphoria Resort's Elxi option scales from the couple up to 10 guests.

faq.q: Is the legal ceremony part of an all-inclusive package?
faq.a: Sometimes help with the documents is, as each venue entry above sets out, while fees set by the municipality or church can sit outside. Check the requirements with the municipality and the Australian Embassy in Athens.
